newsitem.title: UK: LME reprimands Rotterdam warehouse company.
newsitem.headline: LME reprimands Rotterdam warehouse company.

text.p: The London Metal Exchange (LME) has reprimanded Rotterdam company Albatros Warehousing BV after enquiring into alleged breaches of conditions of contract between it and the LME.
In a notice to all members, warehouse companies and their London agents the LME said.

"After a full investigation, an LME warehouse disciplinary committee has determined that Albatros Warehousing BV, Rotterdam has breached the conditions by a) failing to maintain accurate records, b) failing to properly issue LME warrants and c) submitting incorrect stock returns on a number of occasions.
The LME said its notice was issued by way of a reprimand to demonstrate the seriousness with which the Exchange views such incidents.
